text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ——In this blood dwells pride. In this soul resides……

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……"The Strongest."
I stretched beneath the morning sky. Just past 5 AM.
Few runners were out at this hour. Only two on the track——……
——I recognized that figure immediately. At Tracen Academy, her name preceded her.

text_block_list.name: Previous Generation Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Thanks for joining my workout. I know you have a tight schedule……——

text_block_list.name: Previous Generation Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Duramente.
Ever since her arrival, she drew eyes. A buzz constantly surrounded her.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl Looking On From a Classroom
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san comes from that lineage, right? Not just turf racing, but the entire athletic world…… true legends.

text_block_list.name: Trainer With Knit Cap
text_block_list.text: Her grandmother, her great-grandfather. Athletic prowess is in their bones. That pedigree rewrites history in whatever sport they touch.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Wearing Red Lipstick
text_block_list.text: Different arena from her ancestors, but those legs are unmistakable. She will leave an indelible mark on racing.

text_block_list.name: Stylish Trainer
text_block_list.text: Flawless posture, just like her mother and grandmother before her. Both were peerless runners. Truly——

text_block_list.name: Everyone Watching Duramente
text_block_list.text: Indeed, she is——the culmination of that bloodline.
Generations devoted to absolute athletic supremacy, crystallized in this one girl.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……Three furlongs, 600 meters side-by-side. Correct?

text_block_list.name: Previous Generation Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: Yes. Give me everything. I am ready. ……Resolved, too.
I hurried down the stairs. I needed to witness this up close. Right before my eyes——!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
Haa…… haa…… haa!
Haa…… haa…… kh!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Aaaaaaaah!
Anyone watching would be captivated. That run was pure, undeniable——

text_block_list.name: Previous Generation Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Haa…… whew…… haha……
So fast…… completely outmatched.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Over a longer distance, the outcome remains uncertain. Once you hit top gear, your pace never dropped.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Formidable lung capacity and power. ……I could learn much from it.

text_block_list.name: Previous Generation Horsegirl
text_block_list.text: ……! Ahahaha, you're far too generous. Thank you for your time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Likewise. Should the opportunity arise, let us run again.
With that, Dura crouched down and began massaging her ankles——
Another reason drove me toward her. Miss this chance, and another might never come.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……And you are?
Faced with her guarded gaze, I quickly explained my purpose.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……? Taping and mobility drills are routine. There is no pain. I would not be reckless at this stage.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: This is purely preventative maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: My ankles have high stiffness. A double-edged sword: immense power output, heightened injury risk. Our home trainer drilled that into me.
A known physiological trait. High reward, high risk.
For top speed, foot strike angle is critical. Less ankle flexion means greater force transferred directly into forward propulsion.
Higher stiffness yields higher velocity. Shorter ground contact time maximizes propulsion.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Is there anything else?
Heat rose to my face. She remained composed, unmoved. But if I hesitated here, the door would close——

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: …………If you will excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: My apologies, but I am currently declining all scouting proposals.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……The Selection Race approaches. The arena where debutants demonstrate their worth to trainers.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Starting there, I will prove it on the turf.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ……"The Strongest."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Like my ancestors who reshaped eras, I too pursue the summit. I will rewrite the history of racing.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Records, memories, emotions——I will overwrite them all. To prove I am "The Strongest."
Overwrite everything. Even without seeing the full picture, her triumph over elite competition felt inevitable.
She was destined for the top. A presence so commanding, supremacy felt preordained——
……Yes, I was certain. What unfolded next was unthinkable.

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: A new star emerges in this Selection Race, eclipsing the heavy favorite! Taking first place is——……
——There, I witnessed her defeat.
